rig: Better than before: the grey card reads grey, the scale corners are honest, and repeat/ and vs_concept are the most useful views. Misleading: (1) a cyan rectangular fill card shows up as solid cyan polygons on every glossy material (obsidian, lacquer, lava_glass, basalt); use a dark environment with small lantern and glowworm points like the concepts instead. (2) Emissives (lava_flow, lava seams, neon, washi_backlit) are desaturated to cream by AgX plus bloom. Show them with an exposure-matched view or a false-colour luminance strip. (3) 13 of the scale/__context shots are stale (17:58-18:01, older textures); the stone ones should not exist at all according to the script. Delete them. (4) Close-ups have strong DOF blur and hide micro detail; use f/8. (5) Water is shown from above; add a 1.6 m grazing view with lanterns behind so Fresnel and reflection are judged. Next round: one in-situ vignette per slice room (arrival floor + wall + lava window; corridor stones in water with andon; mirror pool) at 1.6 m under scene-like lighting.
top_fixes: 1. Emission grading: lava_flow, lava seams, neon and backlit washi clip to cream. Keep saturated orange, magenta and amber with lower intensity; fixes the arrival-hall lava window
2. water_still/river: teal underglow and depth absorption (0.1 m teal to 2 m blue-black), visible bed with caustics, transparency; no opaque paint
3. obsidian: drop the planar mirror facets and use continuous black gloss with thin fracture lines, plus a wet slab variant for the pool rim
4. Rock family (basalt_wet, cave_rock, stepping_stone, basalt_dry): near-black neutral albedo; mirror wet film on ridges and drips; basalt joints; no marble veins
5. paving: mirror-wet puddle film, darker slabs, crisp joints
6. Tiling failures: ash_clay star-pit lattice, water_sea foam grid, glacier_ice and bronze 1-2 m repeats
7. Metals: iron and bronze need real metallic response, with rust and verdigris in cavities only
8. Wood and fibre identity: aged dark hinoki with raised grain and knots, near-black urushi, a 3-strand rope twist, noren indigo weave and mon, andon kumiko lattice
summary: The shader-first rebuild fixed most tiling: hex-tiled rocks show no repeat at 10 m. Likeness against the concepts is still weak. Materials are too brown and too matte where the concepts are black and mirror-wet. The glowing elements (lava, water glow, neon) lose their colour, so the three slice rooms would miss their signature looks: teal glow, an orange lava window and a black mirror. Woods, cloth and metals read as generic CG, not aged Japanese materials. Most fixes are parameter or mask changes (albedo, film coverage, emission grading), not new textures. Water and lava should be runtime procedural; everything else should stay as anti-tiled textures.
